bio_50_words: Assoc. Prof. Asmaa Rady directs the AI and Machine Learning Engineering and Construction Engineering programs at East Port Said National University, and leads its Huawei Academy and training center. Based at Port Said University, she holds a PhD in renewable energy from the University of Exeter and researches solar photovoltaics, nanofluids and desalination.
